# Accessibility conformance report

<!-- Generated by `node tools/conformance.mjs --write` from tools/conformance/*.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

**Product:** Gravitas 2.0.0  
**Standard:** WCAG 2.1 and 2.2, Levels A and AA  
**Date of evaluation:** 2026-10-17

## What this report is

This is The project's own evaluation. It is not an external audit, and no assistive-technology user has validated it (OWNER_ACTIONS.md lists the external work). It does not claim conformance. A criterion is reported **Supports** only when a method that can judge its whole scope covered the whole scope; a pass by axe-core alone is at most **Partially supports**, with the rules named. **Not evaluated** is used where no method here looked, which is neither a claim of support nor of failure. [ACCESSIBILITY.md](ACCESSIBILITY.md) says what was fixed and what cannot be; its list of honest limitations and this report must agree, and a test fails when they do not.

## Scope: the workflows evaluated

Ten student workflows and the instructor path, by the end-to-end specs that exercise them. Each is judged by the methods below on the surfaces and states those specs open.

| Workflow | What the student does | Specs |
|---|---|---|
| S1 | Start from the front door and open an investigation | `onboarding.spec.js`, `firstRun.spec.js`, `investigations.spec.js` |
| S2 | Run and change a sandbox scenario | `sandbox.spec.js`, `bodyPlacement.spec.js`, `accessibilityParity.spec.js` |
| S3 | Work through an investigation: read, predict, answer, get feedback | `investigations.spec.js`, `answerEntry.spec.js`, `predictionLoops.spec.js` |
| S4 | Measure in an investigation and read a plot | `measure.spec.js`, `plotChart.spec.js`, `chartParity.spec.js` |
| S5 | Open an observation in the Observatory and measure it | `observatory.spec.js`, `stellarSpectra.spec.js` |
| S6 | Use the Sky Lab to plan an observation | `sky.spec.js`, `observing.spec.js` |
| S7 | Run an experiment and read its results | `experimentRunner.spec.js`, `experiments.spec.js` |
| S8 | Finish an investigation and download the report (PDF or web page) | `investigations.spec.js`, `htmlReport.spec.js` |
| S9 | Save, resume and export one's own work | `myWork.spec.js`, `progressSafety.spec.js`, `presetRecovery.spec.js` |
| S10 | Share a scenario by link and open a shared one | `sharing.spec.js`, `shareObserving.spec.js` |
| I1 | Find an investigation, assign it, collect submissions and review them | `adoption.spec.js`, `instructorFlow.spec.js`, `assignment.spec.js`, `submissionReview.spec.js`, `instructorPortal.spec.js` |

Outside the scope: Authoring tools (Scenario Studio, Investigation Composer, course builder) are covered by axe only (e2e/accessibility.spec.js); their workflows were not walked for this report. The generated PDFs are evaluated as documents, not as workflows.

## Methods

| Method | What it is, and what it cannot judge |
|---|---|
| **axe-core automated rules** (`axe`) | e2e/accessibility.spec.js runs axe-core with the wcag2a, wcag2aa, wcag21a, wcag21aa, wcag22aa and best-practice rule sets and no rules disabled, over every surface the spec lists, in both languages, and in all four themes on the pages that carry the shared shell. axe judges a subset of most criteria, reports some checks as incomplete (contrast over images, canvas and gradients), and cannot judge meaning, order or operation. |
| **Scripted manual checks** (`manual`) | e2e/accessibilityManual.spec.js: focus order, focus traps, Escape and focus restoration, heading order, landmarks, reflow at 320 and 640 CSS pixels, reduced motion and the canvas description. A scripted check judges what its assertions state, on the surfaces it opens. |
| **Keyboard and pointer parity** (`parity`) | e2e/accessibilityParity.spec.js and the dialog and body-placement specs: the keyboard and the typed form reach the same state as the pointer. |
| **Responsive layout and target size** (`layout`) | e2e/responsiveLayout.spec.js measures controls on phone and tablet projects, including the 44 px minimum on coarse pointers. |
| **Static inventories** (`static`) | tests/dialogInventory.test.js (every modal opens through js/dialog.js), tests/accessibilityDocs.test.js (every surface is named in the prose), tools/i18n-audit.mjs (both languages on every page) and the shell check (a language and a title on every stamped page). |
| **Inspection of the generated documents** (`pdf`) | tests/instructorMaterials.test.js holds the instructor PDFs to their stated untagged state; tests/evidenceLedger.test.js and tests/htmlReport.test.js check the tagged student report and the web-page report. No PDF/UA validator has been run. |

No method here is a test with assistive-technology users. **Assistive-technology user validation has not occurred**, so no criterion that depends on how a screen reader, switch or voice control behaves is reported as supported.

56 criteria in all: every Level A and AA criterion of WCAG 2.1 and 2.2 (4.1.1 is listed because 2.1 has it; 2.2 removed it).

## Level A

| Criterion | Status | Evaluated by | Remarks |
|---|---|---|---|
| **1.1.1** Non-text Content (WCAG 2.0) | Partially supports | axe-core automated rules; Scripted manual checks; Inspection of the generated documents. axe rules: `image-alt`, `input-image-alt`, `role-img-alt`, `svg-img-alt`, `area-alt`, `object-alt` | Images, icons and the web-page report's figures have text alternatives that axe and tests confirm. The simulation canvas has a generated text description and each plotted series is available as a table in the export dialog and the web-page report. A curve's shape is not narrated, and a description is not equivalent to watching the simulation. The instructor PDFs carry no alternative text. |
| **1.2.1** Audio-only and Video-only (Prerecorded) (WCAG 2.0) | Not applicable | none | The application plays no prerecorded audio or video. It synthesizes sound only on request (the gravitational-wave audio and the sonification), each with a text equivalent. |
| **1.2.2** Captions (Prerecorded) (WCAG 2.0) | Not applicable | none | The application plays no prerecorded audio or video. It synthesizes sound only on request (the gravitational-wave audio and the sonification), each with a text equivalent. |
| **1.2.3** Audio Description or Media Alternative (Prerecorded) (WCAG 2.0) | Not applicable | none | The application plays no prerecorded audio or video. It synthesizes sound only on request (the gravitational-wave audio and the sonification), each with a text equivalent. |
| **1.3.1** Info and Relationships (WCAG 2.0) | Partially supports | axe-core automated rules; Scripted manual checks; Inspection of the generated documents. axe rules: `aria-allowed-attr`, `aria-required-children`, `aria-required-parent`, `definition-list`, `dlitem`, `list`, `listitem`, `th-has-data-cells`, `td-headers-attr`, `scope-attr-valid`, `label`, `landmark-one-main`, `region`, `heading-order` | Pages use landmarks, ordered headings, real lists and tables with header cells, and the scripted manual checks confirm landmark and heading order on the surfaces they open. axe judges only the relationships it can detect. The instructor PDFs are untagged, so they declare no structure; the student reports are tagged but unvalidated. |
| **1.3.2** Meaningful Sequence (WCAG 2.0) | Partially supports | Scripted manual checks; Inspection of the generated documents | Focus and reading order on the surfaces the manual spec opens follow the visual order. No method judges the reading order of every page. The PDFs are read in the order the text was drawn, which is the intended order but is not declared. |
| **1.3.3** Sensory Characteristics (WCAG 2.0) | Not evaluated | none | No method here judges whether an instruction depends on shape, position or color alone. Investigation text that points at the simulation was not reviewed against this criterion. |
| **1.4.1** Use of Color (WCAG 2.0) | Partially supports | axe-core automated rules; Inspection of the generated documents. axe rules: `link-in-text-block` | Links in text are distinguishable without color, and the reports print what kind a number is as a word beside it. Colors in the simulation canvas that distinguish bodies were not evaluated against this criterion. |
| **1.4.2** Audio Control (WCAG 2.0) | Partially supports | Scripted manual checks | Sound starts only when the reader asks for it and stops on the same control. The audio and sonification specs cover those two features, not every control that can make sound. |
| **2.1.1** Keyboard (WCAG 2.0) | Partially supports | Keyboard and pointer parity; Scripted manual checks; Static inventories | Every control reachable by pointer on the evaluated surfaces is reachable by keyboard, and placement has a keyboard form. Dragging to feel a throw has no keyboard equivalent, by design; the typed form gives the number instead. |
| **2.1.2** No Keyboard Trap (WCAG 2.0) | Partially supports | Scripted manual checks; Static inventories | Every modal opens through one module that traps focus within it, restores focus on close and answers Escape (tests/dialogInventory.test.js fails on one that does not). Escape and Tab are checked on the surfaces the manual spec opens. Embedded and third-party frames were not tested. |
| **2.1.4** Character Key Shortcuts (WCAG 2.1) | Partially supports | Scripted manual checks | Single-key shortcuts are ignored while a text field has focus, except Escape. Whether a reader can turn them off or remap them was not evaluated, and the criterion requires it where a shortcut is a single printable character. |
| **2.2.1** Timing Adjustable (WCAG 2.0) | Partially supports | Static inventories | No investigation or report has a time limit. The simulation runs in real time by design, and the reader can pause it. Timed toasts and the start-up failsafe were not evaluated for adjustment. |
| **2.2.2** Pause, Stop, Hide (WCAG 2.0) | Partially supports | Scripted manual checks | Decorative animation stops with prefers-reduced-motion and the simulation can be paused from the transport bar or the space bar. The orbital motion itself does not stop for the media query because it is the content. |
| **2.3.1** Three Flashes or Below Threshold (WCAG 2.0) | Not evaluated | none | No method measures flash frequency or area. No feature is designed to flash; the starfield and the gravitational-wave views were not measured. |
| **2.4.1** Bypass Blocks (WCAG 2.0) | Partially supports | Scripted manual checks; axe-core automated rules. axe rules: `bypass`, `skip-link`, `landmark-one-main` | The skip link is the first tab stop on the simulation page and goes to the main region (e2e/accessibilityManual.spec.js). Other pages were not tested for a skip mechanism; the shared shell's navigation is a short list of groups. |
| **2.4.2** Page Titled (WCAG 2.0) | Partially supports | axe-core automated rules; Static inventories; Inspection of the generated documents. axe rules: `document-title` | Every stamped page has a title that follows the page language, and the PDFs carry a document title. The generated web-page report has a title naming the investigation and the student. |
| **2.4.3** Focus Order (WCAG 2.0) | Partially supports | Scripted manual checks | Focus order, traps and restoration are asserted on the listed surfaces. Not every page was walked. |

## Stated gaps

From [ACCESSIBILITY.md](ACCESSIBILITY.md), "Honest limitations". Each is a limit no amount of ARIA removes; the criteria it touches are never reported as Supports.

| Limitation | Criteria |
|---|---|
| A sentence is not a simulation. | 1.1.1, 1.3.3 |
| The orbital motion itself does not stop for `prefers-reduced-motion`. | 2.2.2 |
| The shape of a curve is not narrated. | 1.1.1, 1.3.1 |
| Direct manipulation has a keyboard equivalent, but not a pointer's. | 2.5.1, 2.5.7 |
| The attribution links in the footer are under 24×24. | 2.5.8 |
| Automated checks are a floor, not a ceiling. | 1.3.1, 1.4.3, 4.1.2 |

## The generated documents

- **Instructor documents (PDF).** The instructor guides, answer keys, activity guides and worksheets are untagged PDFs (no /StructTreeRoot), so they are not PDF/UA conformant and give a screen reader no declared structure or reading order. The same content is on the web in HTML.
- **Student reports.** The student's lab report and evidence report are tagged PDFs (headings, lists, tables, figures with alternative text). No PDF/UA validator has been run on them, so their conformance is not claimed. The same report is offered as an accessible web page (Prompt 127).
- Affects criteria: 1.1.1, 1.3.1, 1.3.2, 2.4.2, 3.1.1. For the untagged instructor PDFs those criteria are **Does not support**; the web pages that carry the same content are the route for a reader who needs structure.

## Updating this report

Edit tools/conformance/criteria.json (a status and its remarks) or product.json, then run `node tools/conformance.mjs --write`. A change to a status that makes a criterion Supports must name the method that judged its whole scope.
